parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outside frame of a door set, made of steel. It provides structural support and alignment for the door. The frame is rectangular and surrounds the door edges.
parts.Functional_description: The outside frame holds the door in place, allowing it to swing or slide properly. It ensures stability and alignment between the door and the wall structure.
parts.Movement_description: The frame itself is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the main door panel of the door set, made of wood. It is rectangular and fits within the outside frame.
parts.Functional_description: The door serves as the movable barrier that opens and closes to allow or restrict access through the doorway.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates or swings about its hinges (or slides if designed as a sliding door) when operated by the user.
